title: Moving Box Calculator
description: Estimate how many moving boxes, tape rolls and wardrobe boxes your move needs, room by room.
howto: Enter how many bedrooms, living rooms and other rooms you are moving.
Read the box count broken down by small, medium and large.
Use the tape and wardrobe box estimates for your supply run.

faqs.a: No — they are planning estimates from standard moving guides (about 8 boxes per bedroom). Pack a few extra of each size.

faqs.q: What are small, medium and large boxes?
faqs.a: Small ≈ 16×12×12 in (books, heavy items), medium ≈ 18×18×16 in (general), large ≈ 24×18×18 in (light bulky items like bedding).

faqs.q: How much tape do I need?
faqs.a: Roughly one roll of packing tape per 12 boxes.
